mandate.benchmark_note: Success = beating SMH (the zero-effort passive version of this same thesis) on total return. If concentration doesn't beat SMH, the extra risk bought nothing.
mandate.risk_budget_note: Matches drawdown_risk_off_pct below -- this is the user's actual sustainable-loss ceiling, not an unexamined default. The drawdown_trim_ladder exists so this line is never discovered by hitting it.
mandate.liquidity_floor_note: No external constraint -- all cash here is tactical dry powder for the ladder/rebalancing, not a protected reserve. cash_band_pct below is a discipline band, not a liquidity requirement.

glide_path.action: raise cash floor toward 15-20%, independent of any drawdown trigger
AI-capex ceiling steps down from 100% to ~70% of invested equity
full mandate review and explicit renewal, or convert to core-holding profile

mandate.review_cadence: annual, or on a glide-path transition, or on user request, or after a -25% risk-off event actually fires -- never renegotiated mid-drawdown as a reaction to that drawdown

notes: Full decision rationale (cluster targets, denominators, AI-capex cap history, risk-control set) moved to POLICY-DECISIONS.md 2026-07-26 to keep this file to live values. Read that file before proposing any change to a value below.
AI-capex concentration is INTENTIONAL (user decision, 2026-07-25) -- do not treat max_ai_capex_factor_pct=100 as a bug or re-flag the concentration as drift.

drawdown_trim_ladder.rationale: Monitor only; trigger volatility alert in briefing
De-risk batch 1 (lowest-conviction names from strategist watchlist)
De-risk batch 2 (mid-conviction names from strategist watchlist)
Immediate risk-off; freeze new deployments, rotate to cash
